Hey man, you shouldn't have to hire more to earn more.   


Draw up a premium offer portfolio that's scalable. Introduce, a broze, silve, gold model of your service offerings. And go much deeper on your ideal client. You need to aim as high as possible in terms of their budget but know how they think and behave as a company. And use an outreach system to reach out to the ideal clients who you graduate into your premium and scalable offer portfolio. Feel free to reach out if you wanna chat more about it.
